etsy.description:
An ADHD quote poster for the chronically curious, always just one more rabbit hole away.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in

HOW TO USE

This listing is a physical poster print, not a substitute for professional medical or therapy advice. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: ADHD results are mostly digital downloads; a physical poster print is a clear differentiator.
Definition prints and funny quote prints are the most common ADHD humor formats in the results.
Amazon ADHD posters lean clinical (iceberg charts, therapy office prints); few are jokes.
